answers.text: Skip the famous halls at lunch. Head one neighbourhood over for the small market counters, then walk it off along the quiet park paths.

asks.text: I'm in New York with 2 hours and $40. No crowds, please — I love food.

drops.costRange: Free to enter, bring $10 for coffee after
drops.exactPlace: Meet at the Pool, West 100th-103rd St entrance, Central Park
drops.fuzzyLocation: North end of Central Park, about a 10 minute walk from the nearest subway stop
drops.meetDetail: Steph will be waiting by the west side of the Pool, with binoculars to lend.
drops.title: Central Park is loud today. The north woods are not.
drops.warning: Paths are muddy after rain. Wear shoes that can get dirty.
drops.whyNow: Weekend crowds stay south. This morning the warblers are moving through the quiet north end, and almost nobody walks up there before 10.

drops.exactPlace: Exact cafe name and address, revealed when you unlock (example Drop)
drops.fuzzyLocation: Cambridge side of the river, a short walk from a Red Line stop
drops.meetDetail: Marcus can meet you outside and introduce you to the owner.
drops.perfectFor: Readers, families escaping the rain, anyone with 2 slow hours
drops.title: Rainy in Boston? Skip the long line. This little bookstore cafe is warm.
drops.warning: It only seats about twenty, and when it's full, it's full. Best to go before 2 pm.
drops.whyNow: The famous history stops are full of school groups in the rain today. This small bookstore cafe is quiet, easy on the wallet, and the owner is around until 4.

drops.exactPlace: Exact shore access point, revealed when you unlock (example Drop)
drops.fuzzyLocation: Quiet shore on the Ellsworth side of the bay, about 20 minutes from the busy park entrances
drops.meetDetail: Suzy can meet you at the trailhead at 6:30 pm.
drops.perfectFor: Sunset without the crowd, photographers, couples
drops.title: Acadia is packed. A quieter sunset spot 20 minutes away.
drops.warning: The rocks get slippery at dusk. Bring a flashlight for the walk back.
drops.whyNow: The sunset lots on Cadillac fill up by 5. This shore faces the same light with far fewer people, and tonight the sky is clear.

drops.exactPlace: Exact meeting point, revealed when you unlock (example Drop)
drops.fuzzyLocation: A quiet river mouth within 25 minutes of Ellsworth
drops.meetDetail: Seth brings the rods. You bring warm layers.
drops.perfectFor: Beginners who want to actually catch something
drops.title: The tide turns at dawn. That is when the fish are honest.
drops.warning: You'll need a Maine fishing license for the day. Seth can tell you where to pick one up.
drops.whyNow: Tomorrow's early tide and light wind line up just right. Seth is free at first light, and the usual spots will still be empty.

drops.exactPlace: Exact street and first stall, revealed when you unlock (example Drop)
drops.fuzzyLocation: Central Kyoto, a few minutes from the famous market street
drops.meetDetail: Yuki will meet you at the corner lantern at 6:30 pm.
drops.perfectFor: Food lovers who want the real evening Kyoto
drops.title: Skip the famous food street tonight. Locals eat one street over.
drops.warning: Many stalls take cash only, and photos aren't welcome everywhere. Just follow Yuki's lead.
drops.whyNow: The famous market street will be packed tonight. One street over — where the shop staff eat after work — is at its best after 6.

drops.costRange: Entrance ticket plus Dula's walk price
drops.exactPlace: Exact dawn meeting point, revealed when you unlock (example Drop)
drops.fuzzyLocation: Village side of Sigiriya, away from the main tour bus entrance
drops.meetDetail: Dula will meet you by the lake at 5:45 am, binoculars in hand.
drops.perfectFor: Early risers, birders, anyone who'd rather skip the lines
drops.title: Sigiriya before the buses: birds, quiet lakes, and the rock in morning light.
drops.warning: Start before sunrise, and carry water — there's none on the steps.
drops.whyNow: By 9, the rock is busy and hot. At dawn, the village lakes are full of birds, and you can be up and down before the crowds arrive.

events.detail: Tamara makes cheese the slow way, right here in Ellsworth. Come taste this season's wheels, meet the maker, and take a wedge home. Small table, friendly people, no rush.
events.name: Tamara's Cheese Tasting
